plugins.name: Cross-Project Knowledge
plugins.description: Link projects that talk to each other (a mobile app, a web API, the NuGet or npm package with their models) and see the contracts they serialize and deserialize, the endpoints between them and the packages they share, drawn as a map, with drift flagged. Agents get the same links as tools.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Databases
plugins.description: Your Postgres, MySQL, SQLite and SQL Server databases in one place, read-only: browse tables, run queries with a history, and see the schema as a class diagram with keys, relations and their cardinality (join tables and relations without a foreign key found for you, Mermaid, PlantUML and SVG export). Paste a URL or a SQL Server connection string. Agents query and describe them by name without ever seeing the credentials.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Example: hello
plugins.description: Example of every plugin feature: an agent CLI (Gemini), a recipe, palette and voice tools, and code.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Knowledge Base
plugins.description: Turns each project into a graphify knowledge graph you explore as a live 3D galaxy, a flat glowing galaxy or a plain 2D map, and replay call flows step by step. Agents query it with tools and you watch what they look at.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Prompt Library
plugins.description: Save the prompts you keep retyping, with {{placeholders}} you fill in when you use them. Send one to an agent from the palette or by voice, broadcast it to every agent, or start a new agent with it.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Screen Recorder
plugins.description: Record the browser panel or the Android mirror and save it as an MP4, with the record button on the panel, from the palette, by voice or by an agent showing off what it built.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Secrets
plugins.description: Keep API keys, environment variables and logins in your keychain. Agents use them by name without ever seeing the values.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Task Board
plugins.description: A shared board per workspace where agents post, claim and finish tasks and leave notes for each other, so several agents work as a team.
plugins.author: winfer

plugins.name: Telegram
plugins.description: Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, and approve, decline or answer it from your phone while you're away.
plugins.author: winfer
